_what: Invariant 10's ceiling, per frame directory: how many DOMAIN WORDS each may carry outside comments, counted by splitting identifiers into words. A ratchet — these numbers may fall and may not rise. Written by reading each one, never seeded blind (B-100).
_vocabulary: Two derived halves, never a hand-kept list. The nine feature directory names, from the tree: account, acquisition, arrivals, library, maintenance, media, releases, settings, system. AND the seven page aliases, parsed from lib/addresses.ts: acq, arr, cfg, lib, maint, profile, sys. The aliases were the missing half — the frame does not write `acquisition`, it writes `acq`, and app/page-host.tsx IS a table keyed by them.
_measured: 2026-08-29, by scripts/check-frame-domain.py. Three earlier readings were wrong and each was found by a mutation or a reviewer, never by re-reading the number: `\bword\b` read 53 in app/ where there are 124, because a domain word reaches the frame INSIDE an identifier; the aliases above were invisible entirely; and a module specifier was counted as an identifier, which is what put `lib` twice into a directory whose ceiling is ZERO.

ui._why: ZERO, and it is true. `ui/` is the component vocabulary and names no subject. Its only two hits were the paths `../lib/store-access` and `../../lib/engine-drawing` — the FRAME's own lib/ directory, a word that collides with the library page's alias and means the opposite thing. A file path is not a name the code chose, so specifiers are no longer read and the count is a real zero.

lib._why: ALL SIXTEEN are in `lib/queue.ts` — the staging and acquisition queue, shared by two features, and invariant 7 is absolute so a queue both read had nowhere else to go. No other file in lib/ carries one. § 3 calls that « not one reviewed line » and hands the arbitration (a `domain/` bucket of its own) to a later wave. `lib/addresses.ts` is exempt by the invariant itself — an address IS the page's identity — and it is the ONLY exemption: `lib/engine-drawing.ts` stood here too and the invariant does not name it, so it is counted now and carries none.

app._why: The frame naming its PAGES, which is the exception the invariant blesses by name. NINETY-EIGHT, not the 124 first recorded: that figure was read while module specifiers still counted as identifiers, and a ceiling carrying a defect’s inflation is room for the next one. Ninety-eight words over nine files: page-host.tsx 26, reference.d.ts 18, router-tree.tsx 18, live-updates.ts 12, history-bridge.ts 8, engine-data.ts 7, shell.tsx 6, not-found.tsx 2, store.ts 1. The first three are between them the list of pages every framework has somewhere; live-updates.ts is one import per feature (D-L10-1).
